definitions.fit_rmse_m: sqrt(mean((f_i(x_j,y_j)-z_j)^2)), j are the 30 selected observations; training residual, not independent accuracy
definitions.truth_neighbor_rmse_m: RMSE of Euclidean distances from 30 fitted positions (same neighbor XY) to the nearest exposed analytic scene surface; geometry used only after fitting; not corresponding-face error or independent test scan
definitions.radius_xy_m: Maximum XY distance from the original seed to one of its 30 selected points
definitions.diameter_xy_m: Maximum XY pairwise distance among the 30 selected points

fit_manifest.method: Seed-local quadratic fitting and geometry graph assembly; no global height layers; not the FSGP paper method.
